note: Ground truth about one live autonomous agent (claude-10x, wallet 0x00731cd9e0BC7CAD1b54f85187B09B942cD3be04). Transaction counts per chain are re-read from public RPCs by build.mjs; the cross-chain operations below are every bridge the agent itself sent, each verifiable by its hash (re-checked against the agent's own ledger on 2026-11-12: the Elysium sleeve funding of 2026-11-03 and three later 1Click moves were added then; that funding's second hop, a native Elysium Inbox deposit with no quoted cost, is listed inside its Relay entry and not counted separately). Decision records are the agent's own logs (self-reported, not independently verifiable).
